title: Huế 3D — pilot demo

assumptions.ground: GLO-30 is a 30 m surface model. 'Ground' here = 15th percentile of land cells in a 120 m window + 60 m Gaussian smoothing, clamped to >= 2.0 m. It is a smooth stand-in, not a terrain survey.
assumptions.water_level: River network drawn at 0.5 m (the flattened GLO-30 value). Isolated ponds/lakes: lowest bank ground minus 0.7 m. River bed depth is invented (0.6-3.5 m).
assumptions.road_width: Road widths come from the OSM class (and lanes x 3.3 m when tagged) — inferred, not measured.
assumptions.bridge_deck: Deck elevation = constrained model: ground level at both ends, smooth ramps, flat plateau at max(end ground, water + clearance). Clearance 6.5 m for bridges >= 150 m, 2.2 m for shorter ones, 1.5 m for free-standing footbridges; sidewalks follow the road bridge beside them — assumed values, not surveyed.
assumptions.truong_tien: Cầu Trường Tiền: 6 equal spans along OSM way 174759688 (published: 6 spans of ~67 m, 402.6 m). Arch rise 9 m, girder depth 1.2 m, pier size are assumptions for illustration.
assumptions.building_height: Height = OSM height tag, else floors x 3.3 m, else Google Open Buildings 2.5D estimate (ML, 2023), else 4.5 m default. Roofs are flat.
assumptions.walls: Citadel rampart extruded 6.6 m and Imperial City walls 4 m (published figures, not measured). Gates are cut wherever a mapped road crosses.
assumptions.landmarks: Ngọ Môn, Kỳ Đài, Điện Thái Hòa are parametric sketches from published dimensions; proportions of tiers and roofs are assumed.
assumptions.trees: Trees are scattered at random (fixed seed) inside ESA WorldCover tree-cover cells, away from buildings/roads/water. Positions and heights are not real.
assumptions.simulation: UAV physics, collisions and water spray are arcade-style. Not for flight planning.
